extracted_concepts.name: 不等实根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ>0，r₁,r₂ 不等实根，通解 y = C₁e^(r₁x)+C₂e^(r₂x)

extracted_concepts.name: 重根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ=0，重根 r，通解 y = (C₁+C₂x)e^(rx)

extracted_concepts.name: 共轭复根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ<0，共轭复根 α±βi，通解 y = e^(αx)(C₁cos βx+C₂sin βx)

extracted_concepts.name: 参数变易法
